title: Lazy effort
body:
I downloaded this as per an offer seen on reddit and was very excited to try it out, but it’s just a lazy scam. The games are a kid-level - I used many similar apps and was never “outperforming 99% of my peeps” until now. Some are beyond lazy, for example, a game asking you to memorize the numbers (which always seem to have 4 digits) and then several cases in the row the test asks you to say… how many digits did the number have.
And then there’s the worst - you play the games for nothing except for badges. There’s no profile, no trackable progress to see how you’re doing as you play, or how are you progressing in any of the areas (maths, patterns, memory, etc). Not recommended at all.
